meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 产品经理与项目管理专家在应对复杂项目时，使用此技能可动态组建包含“执行、指挥、评审”的专属AI团队。实时查看多智能体辩论与决策全过程，共享统一上下文记忆，一键完成从会议决策到系统构建的全流程高效协同！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建AI团队协同处理复杂项目，实时查看多智能体决策过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要多智能体协助管理复杂项目、决策与执行。
copy.tagline_en: Build an AI team to handle complex projects, watch multi-agent decisions live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent assistance in managing complex, decision-heavy projects.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按任务从「执行、指挥、评审」三层里挑 AI 角色组队，多个智能体共享同一份数据库记忆，实时展示各自发言、辩论与决策过程，最后汇总成统一结果。
howto.when: 当需要多个智能体协同完成任务时，或需要管理特定场景的智能体组合时触发；任务简单时也可只用单个智能体。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估微服务架构的可行性
say.note: 会看到主持人引导、各角色发言辩论到形成共识

say.text: 请用OPC团队构建AI短视频领域的系统
say.note: 战略分析、产品架构、自动化工程依次输出

say.text: 请用产品团队制定这款产品的定价策略
say.note: 市场分析、成本核算与定价讨论全程可见

howto.what_en: Claude dynamically picks AI roles from execution, command, and review layers to form a task-specific team, shares one database memory, shows each agent's statements, debate and decisions live, then merges output into one result.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs several agents working together, or when you need to manage agent combinations for a specific scenario; a simple task can use a single agent.

say_en.text: Use the tech decision team to assess whether we should adopt microservices.
say_en.note: You watch the host guide debate until consensus forms.

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system for the AI short-video field.
say_en.note: Strategy, product architecture, then automation engineering.

say_en.text: Use the product team to set pricing for this product.
say_en.note: Market analysis, cost review, and pricing debate stay visible.
